QuestInfo.name: How to Meet Mu Gong
QuestInfo.0: The letter issued by #o9300351# of the Black Wings... In order to deliver the letter to #p2091007#, you first must win over #p2091011#, who is one of his students. You'd better head over to #b#m925020000##k and start sweet-talking #p2091011#.
QuestInfo.1: You ask nicely to see #p2091007#, but #p2091011#'s stance remains the same: NO! So, you decided to sweeten the pot, as instructed by #p2090004#, by offering healthy items for the body, which worked like magic. You'd better start gathering some #b#t400591#s#k.\r\n\r\nYou can find good Bellflowers by going through the #rSecret Portal behind the pillar#r right of So Gong.
QuestInfo.2: When you brought the #t4000591#s to him, #p2091011# discreetly told you the way to #m925020000#'s back alley. In front of #m925020000# are some flags. You need to use the portal under the green flag on the right side to get to #p2091007#.

0.0: What do you want here?! This is the Training Center. Keep your attitude in check!\n#b#L0#I'd like to meet Mu Gong. It's very important.#l\n#k
0.1: Then you must take on the entire Mu Lung Dojo! Mu Gong is on the very top floor, awaiting challengers!\n#b#L0#Hey, isn't there a way I can see Mu Gong by taking a backalley shortcut or something...?#l\n#k
0.2: Nonsense! What are you saying! How dare you suggest such a dastardly way to reach the top! \n#b#L0#One word, Bellflower.#l\n#k
0.3: ...Hmph...\n#b#L0#Bellflowers. The best thing a body could get.#l\n#k
0.4: ...No... no... I can't. I can't.\b#b#L0#100 Bellflowers. They're good for the body.#l\n#k

1.0: Ohhhh! Oops, that was too loud. (Whispers) Did you bring what you promised?

yes.0: Ohhh...hahaha...this...this will make me even stronger than I already am. Hahaha...hey, you're still here?
yes.1: Oh yes, you wanted to see our master. There's only one way to meet him without having to fight the entire training center and that is to take the shortcut. #bThere are flags outside the Mu Lung Dojo. I'll activate the hidden portal located behind the GREEN FLAG on the RIGHT#k.

item.0:
(Whispers) Hey, haven't you found #b100 #t4000591#s#k yet? You're going to keep your promise, aren't you?
